detail.longDescription: Google has two apps you can use to upload and share photos: Google Drive and Google Photos. That might seem like one too many, especially since they pull from the same storage. But the goal of each app is different. For everyday photos and videos you take on your phone, Google Photos is fantastic at organizing and editing them, backing them up, and making it easy to find what you're looking for.
